governingAddedSpans.text: XML selectors start with exactly one slash, then child-element segments named [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]* or *, optionally followed by [positive safe integer]. Other selector syntax is invalid before execution.

originalSourcePassages.text: The current registries are closed-loop-json-selector/1 and closed-loop-xml-selector/1. closed-loop-json-selector/1 MUST support at least: the root `$`; child access by identifier name and by single-quoted bracket name; nonnegative array index; and the wildcard `*` over object values and array elements. Selection order is document order. Recursive descent, filters, unions, slices, and script expressions are excluded from version 1. closed-loop-xml-selector/1 MUST support at least: absolute child-element paths from the document root; the element wildcard `*`; 1-based positional index predicates; attribute access `@name`; and `text()` value extraction. All other axes, predicates, and functions are excluded from version 1. A proposition that cannot be faithfully expressed within these registered subsets is not natively representable and routes externally.
